name: Fyta: Spatial & Immersive Videos
summary: FYTA is a spatial social platform for discovering, viewing, and sharing spatial videos, 180° photos and videos, and 360° photos and videos. It is a place where people can capture and explore everyday moments, personal stories, and immersive experiences in a more vivid and engaging way. By bringing together social interaction and next-generation visual media, FYTA makes it easy to connect with others through rich, immersive content designed for the VR era.
